name: Disney Premier Visa Card

apr.notes: 18.24% Min. of (6.75+11.49) and 29.99% to 27.74% Min. of (6.75+20.99) and 29.99% variable APR. 0% promotional APR for 6 months on select Disney vacation packages from the date of purchase, after that a variable APR applies.

fx_fee.notes: Not stated on product page. Preserved as null — not re-verified.

base_rate.description: 1% in Disney Rewards Dollars on all other card purchases.

categories.label: Purchases made directly at DisneyPlus.com, Hulu.com or Stream.ESPN.com
Gas stations and most Disney U.S. locations

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem Rewards Dollars toward Disney experiences such as Disney Theme Park Tickets, Resort stays, shopping, dining and more in the U.S. No block-out dates when redeeming Rewards Dollars. Can use Pay Yourself Back to redeem Rewards Dollars for statement credit toward airline purchases.

signup_bonus.description: Get a $200 Disney Gift Card eGift to use today upon approval + earn a $100 statement credit after you spend $500 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: Special Disney Vacation Financing
benefits.description: Enjoy 0% promotional APR for 6 months on select Disney vacation packages from the date of purchase, after that a variable APR applies.

benefits.title: 10% savings at DisneyStore.com
benefits.description: Save 10% on select purchases at DisneyStore.com when you use your Disney Premier Visa Card.

benefits.title: 10% off select merchandise at Disney Parks
benefits.description: Receive 10% off select merchandise purchases at select locations at the Disneyland Resort and Walt Disney World Resort when you use your Disney Premier Visa Card.

benefits.title: 10% off select dining at Disney Parks
benefits.description: Receive 10% off select dining locations most days at the Disneyland Resort and Walt Disney World Resort when you use your Disney Premier Visa Card.

benefits.title: Disney Card Designs
benefits.description: Choose from more than a dozen designs celebrating Disney storytelling. Once you have the card, you can change your design at any time.

benefits.title: Pay Yourself Back for airline purchases
benefits.description: You can use Pay Yourself Back to redeem Rewards Dollars for a statement credit toward airline purchases made directly with the airline with your Disney Premier Visa Card, including airline travel to any destination, on any airline - with no block-out dates.

notes: Verified from official Chase product page. Network corrected from mastercard to visa based on page title 'Disney® Premier Visa® Card'. Network tier set to null (was 'world' tied to mastercard assumption; page does not state a Visa tier).
